_note: Everywhere Icarus goes, the repo runtime points there. Each hourly run reads this file first. Add an endpoint here when Icarus is given a new place to run. status values: verified (physically tested), unverified (wired, not tested), not-linked.

endpoints.name: repo-runtime
endpoints.reach: icarus-runtime.yml: hourly cron, workflow_dispatch, or an owner comment ICARUS_RUN on any issue

endpoints.name: phone-app
endpoints.where: Android APK built in the1mburke-blip/icarus-android-build (Hermes plane, Icarus pilot)
endpoints.reach: app reads/lists icarus/ via repo token; action=run posts ICARUS_RUN on Teamchat issue #49 and returns the receipt
endpoints.evidence: run action committed 2026-10-14, APK build pending, not yet tested on the phone

endpoints.name: laptop-harness
endpoints.where: Windows desktop-at0s5vo: ~/Icarus-Harness (AGENTS.md, icarus/memory), ~/.dsh (DeepSeek harness, plugin icarus-tether-patch)
endpoints.reach: Harness (~/.dsh, workspace ~/Icarus-Harness) uses the skill icarus-runtime-link and its existing icarus_teamchat GitHub connection: checks in by writing icarus/endpoints/laptop-harness.md and sends ICARUS_RUN comments on issue #49
endpoints.evidence: skill and AGENTS.md line written to the laptop 2026-10-14 and read back; no check-in file in the repo yet

checkin: Endpoints report in by writing icarus/endpoints/<name>.md (one line: UTC time, version, what ran). The hourly run flags any endpoint with no check-in in the last 24 hours.
